```toml
# {{< meta facts.path.config >}}  (or a gitignored {{< meta facts.path.config_local >}})
host = "{{< meta facts.ph.host >}}"            # "{{< meta facts.ph.home_host >}}" at home
personal_repo = "{{< meta facts.ph.personal_repo >}}"

[project]
owner = "{{< meta facts.ph.user >}}"
number = {{< meta facts.ph.project_number >}}
state_field = "{{< meta facts.project.field >}}"

[vault]
path = "{{< meta facts.ph.vault_path >}}"

[daily_notes]
folder = "{{< meta facts.vault.daily_folder >}}"
format = "{{< meta facts.vault.daily_format >}}"

[weekly_notes]
folder = "{{< meta facts.vault.weekly_folder >}}"
format = "{{< meta facts.vault.weekly_format >}}"

[efforts]
on = "{{< meta facts.vault.efforts.on >}}"
ongoing = "{{< meta facts.vault.efforts.ongoing >}}"
simmering = "{{< meta facts.vault.efforts.simmering >}}"
sleeping = "{{< meta facts.vault.efforts.sleeping >}}"
done = "{{< meta facts.vault.efforts.done >}}"
canceled = "{{< meta facts.vault.efforts.canceled >}}"

[frontmatter]
issue_key = "{{< meta facts.fm.issue_key >}}"

[labels]
area_color = "{{< meta facts.label.area_color >}}"

[inbox]
waiting_max = {{< meta facts.inbox.waiting_max >}}
waiting_days = {{< meta facts.inbox.waiting_days >}}
oldest_max = {{< meta facts.inbox.oldest_max >}}

[repos]
core = ["{{< meta facts.ph.personal_repo >}}"]
curious = ["{{< meta facts.ph.team_repo >}}"]   # filled by `gh-inbox cleanup init`

[digest]
orgs = ["{{< meta facts.ph.org >}}"]
rules = [
  "significant features",
  "releases with non-empty notes",
  "juicy architectural or design discussions",
]
```
